description:
FOR SALE BY PUBLIC AUCTION

FEARAUN HOUSE, FEARAUN, SUNCROFT, THE CURRAGH, CO. KILDARE, R56 KA47

RESIDENCE, SUBSTANTIAL FARMYARD & OUTBUILDINGS ON C. 152 ACRES

LOT 1: Fearaun House & substantial farmyard incl. all out buildings, on c. 65.8 acres
LOT 2: Lands at Fearaun comprising c. 72.3 acres 
LOT 3: Lands at Bushypark comprising c. 14.3 acres 
LOT 4: The Entire - Fearaun House, farmyard incl. all out buildings, lands at Fearaun and Bushypark comprising c. 152 acres

Liam Reilly Auctioneers are delighted to bring to the market by Public Auction this substantial residential and agricultural holding extending to c. 152 acres, comprising Fearaun House together with an extensive farmyard and associated agricultural buildings and outbuildings.

The property occupies an excellent location in the renowned Curragh area of County Kildare, an area synonymous with agriculture, bloodstock and equestrian pursuits. Situated close to the National Stud, the world-famous Curragh Racecourse, Suncroft Village and the Curragh Plains, the holding enjoys an attractive rural setting while remaining within convenient reach of Kildare Town, Newbridge, Kilcullen and Naas. The area also benefits from excellent accessibility to the M7 and M9 motorway networks, providing convenient connections to Dublin and the wider region. 

This is a rare opportunity to acquire a substantial landholding with residence, extensive farmyard and outbuildings in a highly regarded County Kildare location.

FOR SALE BY PUBLIC AUCTION
Wednesday, 7th October 2026 @ 3pm in The Keadeen Hotel, Newbridge, Co. Kildare. 

SOLICITOR: Mr. Owen Burke, Hayes Solicitors LLP, Lavery House, Earlsfort Terrace, Dublin 2, Tel: 01-6624747, Email: oburke@hayes-solicitors.ie , www.hayes-solicitors.ie .
